case.title: Publication 596 (ZH-S), Earned Income Credit (EIC), 2025 (Simplified Chinese)
case.author: Internal Revenue Service
case.provenance: IRS prior-year archive copy, byte-identical to irs-pdf/p596zhs.pdf when captured. Antenna House output with Noto Sans CJK Identity-H fonts and ToUnicode maps.
case.rightsBasis: IRS.gov use-of-content page: content created or maintained by federal employees in the course of their duties is not subject to copyright; copyrighted material must be cleared with its holder. Not relicensed under MIT.

rightsClearance.scope: IRS content statement; translation authorship not separately confirmed; no owner confirmation or shipped-catalog admission.

coverage: CJK mixed with Latin identifiers, URLs, form numbers and amounts
line breaks without spaces between CJK words
stray spaces from justified CJK lines
two-column tax publication layout with worksheets
case.downloadVerification: Fresh download through tools/fetch_corpus.py into an empty temporary cache matched this identity on 2026-09-16; see measurements/corpus-candidates-30/verification.json.
case.reviewStatus: Converted with EPUBCheck, progress and 256 MiB Mac RSS gate. Contract protects page-16 CJK prose order and embedded Latin amounts. Rasterized prose (#36) and CJK spacing and heading splits (#42) are unqualified.

knownFidelityIssues.issue: Both text columns become preserved-region crops; only the folio reflows. Page 1 contents and prose are affected the same way.
Spaces inserted inside justified CJK lines and multi-line headings split into separate headings.

case.baselineStatus: Baseline and reviewed contract recorded in measurements/irs-p596-zhs-2025/record.md; included in the corpus gate.
